newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen inching up or stable.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen inching up or stable.

text.p: Polish shares are expected to inch up or stabilise on Thursday on the back of Wednesday's strong post-fixing buying which followed two consecutive losses.
Analysts expected trading volumes to remain thin as the public offering of KGHM Polska Miedz SA copper concern was drawing attention and capital away from the secondary market.
They said however heavy trading in Bank Handlowy, which accounted for 60 percent of the total turnover, signalled some presence of large foreign investors.

Analysts are split over the bourse's performance on Friday and next week with some expecting the market to continue its recent light downtrend, while others await a rebound once the KGHM offer is over.
Analysts said Bank Handlowy, which climbed to 40 zlotys on Wednesday from its Monday's debut at 37.9 zloty should see its price beginning to stabilise.
